name: serum/glucocorticoid regulated kinase 1
pathways: regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator

function.text: SGK1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase Sgk1. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and regulation of signal transduction by p53 class mediator.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: SGK1 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase Sgk1. It is a serine/threonine-protein kinase which is involved in the regulation of a wide variety of ion channels, membrane transporters, cellular enzymes, transcription factors, neuronal excitability, cell growth, proliferation, survival, migration and apoptosis. It contributes to cellular stress response. It contributes to regulation of renal Na(+) retention, renal K(+) elimination, salt appetite, gastric acid secretion, intestinal Na(+)/H(+) exchange and nutrient transport, insulin-dependent salt sensitivity of blood pressure, salt sensitivity of peripheral glucose uptake, cardiac repolarization and memory consolidation.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SGK1 have been reported in t-cell/histiocyte-rich large b-cell lymphoma, nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma, and malignant lymphoma.
